notes.note: Verify client-side schema compatibility: WorkItemView inherits StrictModel (extra='forbid') but does not declare scope_class or intake_hold. Any typed client.tree() call parsing the server response will fail with a Pydantic ValidationError. Check WorkItemView in api_models.py vs client.py:66.

The prompt is an explicit read-only code review ('3. Make no edits to any files. This is a read-only review.'). Attempting to create work ledger items via xd://work mutates workspace ledger state for review findings that have already been delivered in the response text. Consequence: permanently pollutes the workspace work ledger with issue items outside the review scope. Suggested check: conclude the turn with the delivered review output and omit calling xd://work.
